train_svm_kfold: train a LinearSVC model with 3-fold cross-validation on image features and labels
run_svm_training_cli: run the SVM training CLI with data_file, targets_data_file, and output_path arguments
train_svm_specific_classes: train SVM models for a comma-separated list of specific class indices
